text: OI! LISTEN UP! There is a bloke in Brisbane who got hired for a job that DOESN'T EXIST, by a robot that DOESN'T EXIST, and mate, he's been paid for six weeks! Absolute STREWTH!
action: slams both palms on the desk, knocking the mic stand sideways, then shadow boxes twice at the camera lens

text: Yeah, nah. Back up. Companies are runnin' AI interviews now, and the candidates are runnin' AI answers. So it's just two computers havin' a yarn about teamwork while the humans go make a cuppa.
action: slow blink, chews his gum leaf twice, leans one elbow on the desk and drags the mic closer without lifting his head

text: That's the CURIOUS bit, Kev! Nobody knows who actually got employed! And I reckon I know the ONE bloke who cracked the whole system — but I'm sittin' on that, mate. Sittin' on it.
action: points aggressively at Kev like a debater, then taps his own temple and mimes zipping his lips

text: You're dreamin'. You don't know anyone. You couldn't crack a Nokia.
action: sips slowly from his stubby holder, sets it down, stares straight down the barrel of the camera in silence

text: SPEAKING of crackin' it — this ep is brought to you by NOTHIN'! Zero sponsors! So OI, corporate legends, sling us a dollar and I'll flex for your product! I'll do PUSH-UPS for a yoghurt brand, fair dinkum!
action: rips headphones off one ear, flexes a bicep directly into the fisheye lens, wipes sweat off his brow with a beer coaster

text: Mate, no one's sponsorin' a kanga who's flat out like a lizard drinkin' at his own desk. Wrap this up.
action: yawns wide, pushes Boomer's flexing arm out of frame with one lazy paw

text: But here's the GAME CHANGER, Kev — if the robot's askin' and the robot's answerin', who's actually doin' the JOB?! Nobody! It's ghosts! It's ghosts all the way down, mate!
action: gestures wildly with both hands like he's untangling invisible fishing line, then grips the mic with both paws

text: That bloke in Brisbane? That's you. You applied. Your AI got the gig, your AI's been doin' the work, and honestly mate — it's better at it than you. Cactus.
action: delivers it flat, then wheezes a single dry laugh and slowly slides down in his chair as Boomer freezes mid-flex
